name: Legal Document Lifecycle Management
description: Deterministic strategic framework to orchestrate corporate legal compliance, contract drafting, IP assignments, cap table governance, execution tracking, and audit-ready document repositories.
logic: Legal compliance is the bedrock of enterprise value. Missing IP assignments, unexecuted founder contracts, or defective cap table records destroy investor confidence and create catastrophic liability. Maintain single-source-of-truth legal discipline.
chainsOfThought: Step 1: Initiate Legal Audit -> Inventory Corporate Formation, Equity, IP & Material Agreements -> Calculate Compliance Index
Step 2: Template Selection & Draft Generation -> Select Standard Legal Template -> Inject Party Details & Governing Terms -> Draft Agreement
Step 3: Pre-Execution Compliance Scan -> Audit Confidentiality, IP Assignment & Liability Clauses -> Check Governance Consistency
Step 4: Signature & Execution Tracking -> Register Counterparties, Signature Deadlines & Expiration Rules -> Track Signature Status
Step 5: Executive Review & Approval -> Request WebSocket Sign-Off via ExecApprovalManager -> Obtain Human Counsel/Founder Authorization
Step 6: Execute & Store -> Apply Standardized Naming Convention ([Category]_[DocType]_[Party]_[Date]_v[X.X].pdf) -> Archive in Secure Vault
Step 7: Lifecycle & Expiration Monitoring -> Track Renewal Dates, Expiration Triggers & Termination Notice Windows -> Notify Leadership
bestPractices: Every executed agreement must have one designated owner, one approved version, and one authoritative location.
Require explicit human founder/counsel sign-off before executing or releasing any legal document.
All employee and contractor agreements must contain explicit IP Assignment and Non-Disclosure clauses.
